method: Independent random network initialization, supervised warm start on flat/obstacle/gap train only, then PPO gap to mixed. Same algorithm and budgets; all runs reported. Not pure PPO.
acceptance: All three runs must automatically pass flat/obstacle/gap/mixed gates, reload and pass every layout in both modes. Existing v5 test/OOD are regression; v6 IDs are new blind geometry. No holdout-dependent seed or checkpoint selection.
full_selection: Predeclared first seed, not selected by holdout results; begin full only if cohort passes.
